passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Stay emotionally present when you feel the urge to withdraw

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Find contentment independent of any outcome today

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Thank a past version of yourself and consciously let them go

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Act opposite to your 'type' for one decision today

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Give away one thing you're attached to

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Hold one of your beliefs as 'possibly wrong' for a day

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Interact with someone without revealing your title/status

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Tolerate emotional neutrality for one afternoon

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Name one gift that your current age brings

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Do something you enjoy that your partner doesn't, alone

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Choose one small discomfort deliberately (cold shower, difficult conversation)

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Change one routine element and stay present with the discomfort

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Tell yourself a new story about the same events

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: When drawn to negativity, observe the craving without feeding it

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Appreciate one imperfect, real thing about a loved one

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Start learning something where you're a complete beginner

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Leave your phone at home for a 30-minute walk

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Write out the grievance and then physically release the paper

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Ask a genuine question about something you don't understand

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Identify one area where you have choice and exercise it

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Forgive one debt without announcing it

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Practice in complete anonymity — no one needs to know

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Take one calculated risk today
